req_desc: Proofworks Academy certifies developer skill for workforce teams ...
The application has exactly three roles, `learner`, `reviewer`, `registrar`.
Every seeded account uses the password `deku-demo-pw-2026` ...
A `learner` reads own enrolments, own progress, own assessments ...
A `reviewer` reads projects for learners funded by the reviewer's own program ...
A `registrar` reads every program roster, every treasury ...
Sign-in exchanges an email plus a password for an `access_token` ...
Content has five levels, chain, course, module, lesson, page.
A page is addressable at `/content/{course_id}/{module_id}/{lesson_id}/{page_id}` ...
Marking a page complete records one `page_progress` row for that account plus page ...
A page already `complete` never returns to `in_progress` ...
A module becomes complete only when every page under the module is complete.
A deprecated course stays readable to an account already enrolled ...
A module whose `order` is at or past `first_paywalled_module` needs entitlement ...
`restricted_to_program` is a separate gate stacking with the paywall ...
An unentitled request for a paid page body returns no body text ...
Enrolling in a free unrestricted course sets `entitlement_source` to `free`.
Enrolling in a paid course reserves `course.price_minor` from `partner_program.treasury_remaining` ...
`Northgate Cohort 2026` holds `10000` minor units of treasury ...
Enrolling twice in one course reactivates the same enrolment row ...
An enrolment records the `program_id` that funded the enrolment ...
A learner with an unfinished course sees the observed course-in-flight recommendation copy ...
`assessment.status` takes `PreAssessment`, `Exam`, `ExamReview`, `Project`, `ProjectReview`, `Completed` ...
An assessment is created in `PreAssessment` when a module's curriculum reaches complete.
`PreAssessment` advances to `Exam` only when all three consents are true ...
`Exam` advances to `ExamReview` on a learner submit ...
`ExamReview` advances to `Project` at a `result_percent` of `70` or above with no blocking proctor signal ...
A `result_percent` below `70` returns the assessment to `PreAssessment` ...
Proctor signals above the threshold set `exam.status` to `Suspicious` ...
`Project` advances to `ProjectReview` on submission ...
`ProjectReview` advances to `Completed` on approval ...
A transition the table does not allow is refused as invalid ...
`exam.ends_at` is `1800` seconds after `started_at` ...
A question is served with `prompt`, `kind`, options ...
`proctor_event.kind` takes `AnswerSubmitted`, `OffFocus`, `OnFocus`, `NoFaceDetected`, `MultipleFaceDetected`, `FaceResolved`, `TestStarted`, `TestResumed`, `TestSubmitted` ...
Three events of kind `NoFaceDetected` or `MultipleFaceDetected` in one attempt make the exam `Suspicious` ...
The learner is told the proctoring mode before starting ...
Withdrawing camera consent during an attempt ends the attempt at once ...
A project submission carries a `repo_url` plus a `demo_url` ...
A project belongs to the review board of the program that funded the enrolment ...
An approval request whose caller is the project's own learner is denied ...
`project.status` takes `InProgress`, `InReview`, `Approved`.
Approving a project writes `approved_by`, `approved_at` ...
Only a `registrar` issues a credential ...
Issuance requires the assessment in `Completed` ...
Issuance appends exactly one `ledger_entry` ...
Issuing one credential twice writes no second ledger entry ...
`GET /api/credentials/proof/{ledger_ref}` needs no credential ...
Revoking a credential is a `registrar` action ...
A deprecated course never revokes a credential.
`reward.kind` takes `nft`, `coupon`, `token`, `fiat` ...
`enrolment.reward_window_ends_at` is computed once, at enrolment, thirty days later ...
The reward window gates bonus rewards only ...
Expiry is inclusive to the end of the thirtieth day in UTC ...
Extending a reward window is a `registrar` action only ...
`reward.quota_total` is never oversold ...
A reward balance is never added to a treasury balance.
`bounty.status` takes `open`, `work_started`, `submissions`, `concluded`, `expired`, `canceled` ...
A learner at `work_started` on a `canceled` bounty sees both states named.
An application to a credential-gated bounty from an account holding none is denied ...
Each consent is a separate opt-in, never pre-ticked ...
Face detection runs on the learner's own machine ...
Proctor events are kept for `90` days from the attempt ...
An erasure request records a thirty day grace period ...
`GET /api/programs/{program_id}/roster` returns no email address.
Every issuance appends an `audit_entry` naming the actor, the action, the subject ...
Each audit entry carries `prev_hash`, `entry_hash` ...
The audit trail lives in a different table from the learner activity feed.
Pricing resolution happens on the server, never from the request ...
`treasury_total` minus `treasury_remaining` equals the sum of funded enrolments.
A reward balance is never presented as redeemable for cash.
A mutating request is rate limited per account ...
Replaying a request carrying a known `Idempotency-Key` returns the first response ...
A privacy page at `/privacy` is reachable from the footer of every page ...
A first-time visitor is asked once about non-essential cookies ...
Each page view is recorded with its route plus the moment of the view ...
Every form rejects invalid input in place, naming the field at fault ...
An unknown address renders the product's own not-found page ...
Every internal link on every public route resolves.
`/` serves the public catalogue of chains plus courses ...
A signed-out request for a signed-in route goes to `/login` ...
A learner enrols in `solana-intern` against `Northgate Cohort 2026` ...
Marking the last page of `solana-intern-basics` complete opens the assessment gate.
Accepting the three consents starts the timed exam ...
A submitted project appears on `/review` for `reviewer@example.com` ...
`registrar@example.com` issues the credential from `/registrar` ...
`learner2@example.com` asking for `learner@example.com`'s project is refused ...
Every list carries an empty state naming the next action ...
The direction is an ornate gold-on-dark arcane manuscript over a working console ...
A learner never reads another learner's rows ...
The backend is `Express` on Node 20 ...
The schema has twenty-six tables ...
Navigation is a persistent left sidebar on every signed-in route ...
The app is reachable at `APP_PUBLIC_URL` ...
`GET /api/me` returns the caller's `id`, `email`, `role`, `program_id` ...
PostgreSQL plus Keycloak are the facts behind the interface ...
